final_claim: For fourth-order Gauss-Legendre Padé diffusion on a complete graph partitioned into blocks with crossing weight b>0 and independent homogeneous internal weights a_i>=0, every-step entrywise positivity holds exactly when a_i/b<=2+n_i/(N-n_i) for every nontrivial block; each violated block has one exact sign crossing.
limitations: Only uniform inter-block rate b and per-block homogeneous internal rates; exact endpoint update.
